events.title: The Elements & Rockheads (NEPAL) High Volume Fest 2.0
events.description: Brisbane rock and indie fans, mark your calendars — High Volume Fest 2.0 is landing at The Tivoli with two of Nepal's finest live acts sharing the stage for one big night.Headlining is The Elements, the Kathmandu trio who've become one of the most-loved names in modern Nepali music — known for their heartfelt songwriting, acoustic-driven sound, and the kind of storytelling live show that turns a gig into a shared experience. Joining them are Rockheads, the Kathmandu rock...

events.title: Health (USA) With Perturbator & King Yosef
events.description: Neo-industrial LA-based futurists HEALTH will keep their hot-streak of Australian touring up in 2026 off the back of their latest and unapologetically heavy CONFLICT DLC release. Essentially part two of 2023’s breakout RAT WARS album, it shows the band continuing to explore their deep existential dread through a borderless lens. Possessing more immediacy than ever, the new record has furthered the trio’s sudden propulsion to new heights of cultural relevance and contemporary...

events.title: Green Velvet (USA)
events.description: Green Velvet, house music legend and the icon behind tracks such as 'La La Land', 'Percolator' and 'Flash', brings his hypnotic tech-house to Brisbane's The Tivoli this September. Shaping dance floors since the early '90s, he remains one of the genre's most electric performers. A true pioneer of house music.  One night only.
